body:
## 35.0.0 (September 16, 2026)

- NC Governance
- Albums
- New M3 Expressive media player
- New sharing UI for Nextcloud 35
- Faster file listing
- Manual Sync now button for auto-upload when device is in power saver mode
- Auto upload: clean up uploaded files
- Manage tags on files/folders
- Auto upload improvements
- E2EE improvements
- Bugfixes and performance improvements

Minimum: NC 22 Server, Android 9 Nougat

For a full list, please see https://github.com/nextcloud/android/milestone/130
